# W3Schools

> > W3Schools is the world's largest web development learning platform, offering free tutorials and certifications in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SQL, Python, React, Java, PHP, and more.

W3Schools provides interactive tutorials, exercises, and reference materials for web developers and programmers at all skill levels. The platform includes W3Schools Academy for classroom and team training, along with professional certification programs.

## Key Topics

- HTML
- CSS
- JavaScript
- SQL
- Python
- React
- Java
- PHP
- Web Accessibility (WCAG)
- Bootstrap
- MySQL
- C++
- C#
- W3.CSS
- Programming Education

## Core Platform

- [W3Schools Online Web Tutorials](https://www.w3schools.com): Homepage for W3Schools web tutorials: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SQL & more
- [About W3Schools](https://www.w3schools.com/about): About W3Schools learning platform and programming education services
- [About W3Schools](https://www.w3schools.com/about/default.asp): Company info for W3Schools web development tutorials platform

## W3Schools Academy

- [W3Schools Academy - Train Your Team with the World's Largest Web Developer Site](https://www.w3schools.com/academy/index.php): W3Schools Academy team training platform for web development courses
- [Coding and Computer Science Certifications (End of Pathway Exam)](https://www.w3schools.com/academy/certifications.php): W3Schools Academy coding and computer science certification program
- [Coding Exercises](https://www.w3schools.com/academy/academy_code_excercises.php): Coding exercises for HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SQL in W3Schools Academy
- [How TO - Assign Learning Content to Your Students](https://www.w3schools.com/academy/academy_assign_learning_content.php): Guide for teachers to assign content in W3Schools Academy
- [How TO - Student Invitations](https://www.w3schools.com/academy/academy_student_invitations.php): Teacher guide for managing student invitations in W3Schools Academy
- [Teaching Coding Without a Coding Background](https://www.w3schools.com/academy/academy_teaching_coding.php): Resources for non-technical teachers using W3Schools Academy

## Web Accessibility Tutorials

- [Accessibility Forms Introduction](https://www.w3schools.com/accessibility/accessibility_forms_intro.php): Introduction to accessible HTML form design and implementation
- [Accessibility Color Contrast](https://www.w3schools.com/accessibility/accessibility_color_contrast.php): WCAG color contrast guidelines for accessible web design
- [Accessibility Errors](https://www.w3schools.com/accessibility/accessibility_errors.php): Tutorial on handling accessibility errors and WCAG compliance
- [Accessibility Buttons and Links](http://www.w3schools.com/accessibility/accessibility_buttons_links.php): WCAG guide for accessible HTML buttons and links implementation
- [Accessibility Autocomplete](http://www.w3schools.com/accessibility/accessibility_autocomplete.php): Tutorial on accessible autocomplete form controls and WCAG compliance
- [Accessibility Color Alone as Meaning](http://www.w3schools.com/accessibility/accessibility_color_meaning.php): WCAG guideline on avoiding color-only meaning in visual design
- [Accessibility Heading Levels](http://www.w3schools.com/accessibility/accessibility_heading_levels.php): Guide to semantic HTML heading structure for web accessibility
